failure_categories.content_mismatch: Schema-valid output with incorrect category and/or priority.
failure_categories.provider_error: OpenAI API error or missing usage data.
failure_categories.schema_error: JSON parses but fails SupportTriageOutput validation.

latency_measurement: Wall-clock time around provider.generate(), in milliseconds per run.

provider_invocations.description: One provider.generate() invocation per planned run in the executor.
provider_invocations.http_attempts_note: The benchmark live path configures the OpenAI SDK with max_retries=0, so each logical invocation corresponds to one HTTP attempt under normal SDK behavior. The normal application execution path retains the SDK default retry behavior.

purpose: Exploratory, reproducible portfolio evidence for the LLM Decision Reliability Lab using a fixed subset of the built-in evaluation dataset.

accuracy_denominators.category_accuracy: correct category labels / schema-valid runs only
accuracy_denominators.note: Category and priority accuracy are calculated over schema-valid runs only. Use schema_validity_rate and reliability_score to account for failures and invalid outputs.
accuracy_denominators.priority_accuracy: correct priority labels / schema-valid runs only

scoring.consistency: Fraction of repetitions sharing the most common schema-valid (category, priority) outcome within each (dataset_item, prompt_version, model) group.
scoring.quality: Exact comparison of model category and priority against fixed expected labels per dataset item.
scoring.recommendation: Deterministic tie-break cascade in app[redacted-path]; not generated by an LLM.
scoring.reliability: Weighted combination of quality (60%), consistency (20%), schema validity (10%), and provider completion (10%).

statistical_significance: Not claimed. Sample size is intentionally small for portfolio demonstration.

structured_output.validation: Local JSON parse + Pydantic validation; model output is never trusted as-is.

token_and_cost_measurement.description: Observed input_tokens and output_tokens from OpenAI response usage fields when a provider call completes successfully. Reasoning-token or cached-input token breakouts are not captured separately.

limitations: Pricing snapshot is not live; OpenAI rates change over time.
Actual billed cost can differ from estimates.
